Name: More Skin Tones
Author: kioffeeuu
Description:
[center][/center]
[center][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]﻿﻿﻿[size=3]Hey! I'm back again, after a long time. I decided to update my mods just in case some people still like them. :)[/size]

[b]★ How to install? [/b][b]★[/b]

[size=3]☆ Simply download the .rar and extract it into your mods folder.[/size]
[size=3]☆ Once you open the game, a Config file will be generated. [/size]
[size=2][i]There are (at the moment) only three skin options.[/i][/size]
[size=2][i]✭ 1. My Old one (By default).
[/i][i]✭ 2. The "Variety" one.
[/i][i]✭ 3. A "Witchy" one. :)[/i][/size]
☆ In the Config file, you can choose whether of those three you want in your game (Remember, choose only one. Can't have two or all at the same time!).
[size=3]That's it! Please enjoy and have a lovely game! <3[/size]

★ [b]Don't forget! Needs:
[url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]☆ Smapi[/url]﻿
[url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]☆ Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/b]

[size=2][i]★ A little clarification:[/i]
[i]This [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8016][b]★[/b][/url]﻿ used to be the page of this mod. Not anymore, though, since I'm going to keep updating my mods here (and maybe make new ones, if I'm not feeling lazy). So, please, don't download anything from there. Thank you! *^^*[/i][/size][/font][/center]
